Thus, to follow PICO strategy, under our limitations, a questionnaire including at least three of the neuromyths defined by the OECD ( 2002 ) and Centre for Educational Research and Innovation and OECD ( 2007 ) and collected by the first publication that appeared in our screening, was set as intervention.
